event_data.context:
Baseline: eventcore-v2.1.0 (fea3e386cce904e9ef9b76cd303926870d04a692). Acceptance scenarios and Gleam tests are listed at https://github.com/10krco/eventcore-gl/blob/main/docs/parity.md#command-runtime-and-in-memory-store.

PR #2 merged the optimistic store and OTP adapter. PR #3 revision fe4b62d addresses all App findings and passed the full local gate (12 tests). A zero exponential base now stays zero for 65 retries, and the replay fixture verifies replacement of a previously discovered participant and exactly one metrics/trace retry notification. All four threads are resolved. Fresh CI and App review are pending.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the command runtime and in-memory store capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Command runtime and in-memory store
